sentences.en: I will do it on condition that you support me.
sentences.zh: 我会做这件事，前提是你要支持我。

sentences.en: Sally didn't exactly agree with Bill, but she supported him.
sentences.zh: 莎莉并不完全同意比尔的观点，但她支持他。

sentences.en: That amount of crops isn't enough to support their economy.
sentences.zh: 那产量不足以支撑他们的经济。
